capabilities: Toggle individual or all CSS snippets from a status-bar menu
Create new snippets from a template via a modal
Rename snippet files and reopen them in the default editor
Filter the snippet list with a search box
Reload the snippets folder and open it in the file manager
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A rewrite of the unmaintained MySnippets plugin against the current Obsidian API.
motivation: The original MySnippets plugin was unmaintained, so the author rewrote it against the current Obsidian API.
problem: Managing CSS snippets normally means navigating to Settings, and there is no quick way to toggle, rename or create them from anywhere in the vault.

relations.evidence: A rewrite of the unmaintained MySnippets plugin against the current Obsidian API.

summary: Status-bar menu that lets you toggle, create, rename, search and reload CSS snippets without opening settings.
